title: Prophetic Hope Matrix
purpose: Compare original audience, covenant problem, promised action, New Testament use, and unresolved fulfilment questions.
body_markdown:
# Prophetic Hope Matrix

| Passage | Original audience and crisis | Promised divine action | Transformation or creation image | New Testament use | Unresolved hinge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jeremiah 31 | | | | Hebrews 8 | |
| Ezekiel 36 | | | | 2 Corinthians 3 / broader synthesis | |
| Isaiah 65 | | | | Revelation 21 / broader synthesis | |

## Guardrails

- Keep Israel and Judah visible in the original promise.
- Distinguish quotation from broader synthesis.
- Do not require one millennial timetable.
- Do not claim more detail about renewed creation than the texts support.
